title: Revision of Periodicity of KYC Updation for High-Risk Customers

paragraphs.text: Reference is invited to paragraph 4 of circular GZ-KYC-2019-02 dated August 20, 2019, which prescribes the periodicity of KYC updation for high-risk customers. In view of the higher money laundering risk posed by such customers, it has been decided to shorten the re-KYC interval for high-risk customers.

With effect from April 1, 2023, paragraph 4 of circular GZ-KYC-2019-02 dated August 20, 2019 on the periodic updation of KYC for high-risk customers stands substituted by the text set out in paragraph 3 of this circular, which shall thereafter be read as paragraph 4 of circular GZ-KYC-2019-02.

Periodic updation of KYC (re-KYC) for high-risk customers shall be carried out at least once in every 12 months from the date of account opening or the date of the last KYC updation, whichever is later.

The periodicity of KYC updation for medium-risk and low-risk customers remains unchanged: re-KYC for medium-risk customers shall continue to be carried out at least once in every 84 months, and for low-risk customers at least once in every 120 months, as provided in paragraph 5 of circular GZ-KYC-2019-02.

Transition for high-risk customers under the revised re-KYC periodicity: periodic updation of KYC for every high-risk customer whose last KYC updation was completed during the financial year 2020-21 shall be completed by June 30, 2023.

Transition for high-risk customers under the revised re-KYC periodicity: periodic updation of KYC for every high-risk customer whose last KYC updation was completed during the financial year 2021-22 shall be completed by September 30, 2023.
